title: Users & permissions
hint: Add admin accounts and choose which sections each one can edit. Permissions are enforced on the server, not only on screen.

roleHints.readonly: Sees the whole admin page, can’t change anything
roleHints.viewer: Sees the board screen only, no admin page
roleHints.staff: Administrative account — edits the selected sections only
roleHints.staff_manager: Edits the selected sections, and can manage staff accounts if you allow it

passwordHint: At least {n} characters. Hand it to the account owner; they can change it after signing in.
passwordTooShort: Password is too short — at least {n} characters
passwordOnce: Password — copy it now, it won’t be shown again:
confirmReset: Create a new password for {email}? The old one stops working immediately.
confirmBan: Suspend {email}? They can’t sign in until you reactivate them.
usernameHint: Optional if there’s an email. Lowercase letters, digits and . _ -
usernameRule: Username: 3–30 characters — lowercase letters, digits and . _ -, starting with a letter or digit
emailHint: Leave it empty and the account signs in with the username only
needOne: Enter an email or a username — at least one
accessLocked: You can change the username here. Permissions can’t be changed for your own account or the demo account.
sessionExpired: Your session ended (you were signed out on another device). Sign in again and continue.
emailEditHint: Change it, or clear it (a username must remain) so the account signs in with the username only
newPasswordHint: Leave it empty to keep the current one. If you set one (at least {n} characters) it shows once after saving so you can hand it over.
staffAccountsHint: “Manage staff accounts”: creates Staff accounts, resets their passwords, suspends and deletes them, and can only give them sections they have themselves — never touches manager or admin accounts.
staffHint: You can create and edit Staff accounts and give them sections you have yourself. Manager and admin accounts are handled by a full admin.
